mechanism: Omeprazole inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, increasing erythromycin plasma concentrations and risk of toxicity; erythromycin may also inhibit omeprazole metabolism.
action: Monitor for erythromycin toxicity signs (nausea, abdominal pain, arrhythmias); consider alternative antibiotic if prolonged use required; separate administration timing may provide modest benefit.
